item.title: 5,000-year-old skulls reveal a disturbing secret of ancient Egypt's first kings
item.description: A 5,000-year-old mystery surrounding the tombs of Egypt’s first kings has taken a disturbing turn. The findings support a century-old theory that royal attendants were sacrificed when kings died, possibly to serve them in the afterlife. Fuente: ScienceDaily.
